user_reported_action: User confirmed a short physical press/release of the RP2040 RUN button during the second armed PicoScope recording.
probe: CH A, user-reported JMP3 Pad2 KNX_TX (U9 pin24), 10x, ground clip reportedly PCB GND; physical pad/clip not independently inspected

scope.hardware_trigger: positive edge over 0.35 V at probe tip
scope.why_no_raw_waveform: PicoScope hardware did not report a threshold crossing. A triggered ADC block is stored only when the threshold is crossed. A lack of trigger cannot exclude subthreshold or extremely short transients.

reset_usb_evidence.time_resolution_caveat: COM-port enumeration polled about every 150 ms. Event timestamps mark observation, not precisely when physical RUN pin changed or duration of reset.
reset_usb_evidence.interpretation: COM7 disappeared and reappeared while Pico trigger active, consistent with user-reported reset.
reset_usb_evidence.first_run_limited: Initial run01 timed out without an observed reset; excluded as reset evidence.

after_run_firmware.actual_response: KNX043 STATUS armed=0 listen=0 buffered=0 dropped=0

safety_conclusion.conclusion: A USB RUN/reset-associated COM re-enumeration was witnessed during a properly armed 0.35V rising-edge Pico trigger, without a trigger. No significant >=0.35V rising transition was detected at the probed signal; this observation alone does not guarantee fail-LOW on ROM/BOOTSEL/brownout or actual KNX-powered circuitry.
